A company's cash runway is the amount of time it would take to burn through its cash reserves at its current cash burn rate. In June 2026, MapLight Therapeutics had US$305m in cash, and was debt-free. In the last year, its cash burn was US$175m. So it had a cash runway of approximately 21 months from June 2026.
